title: JWT Bearer Token Authentication for AI Multi-Agent System
description: Implement secure JWT-based authentication for FastAPI endpoints to enable protected agent communications and user identity verification across the multi-agent system.
acceptance_criteria: JWT tokens are created with configurable expiration via environment variables
Token verification extracts user_id and validates signature and expiration
FastAPI dependency injection provides optional authentication for protected endpoints
Invalid or expired tokens return HTTP 401 with appropriate error message
Authentication does not break existing unprotected endpoints

items: JWT Bearer token authentication using HS256 algorithm
Token creation with user_id subject claim
Token expiration handling with configurable duration
Signature verification using secret key from environment
AuthResult class provides user_id and authenticated status
get_current_user FastAPI dependency for protected routes
JWT_SECRET environment variable for secret key
